adaptations.ownership: C's raster_tile pointer transfer is represented by TileCache::put(key, Tile): success consumes the owned Tile; failure returns (CacheError, Tile), preserving caller data. The C borrowed pointer from get becomes Option<&Tile> tied to the mutable cache borrow, preventing use across mutation/destruction. Drop releases all owned tile vectors safely.
adaptations.allocation: Vec::try_reserve_exact is used for bounded slots. Metadata charge is reserved slot capacity multiplied by size_of::<Option<Entry>>(), including allocator over-reservation, plus each tile's allocated_byte_count() (the RGBA Vec capacity, including spare bytes). Construction rejects metadata beyond byte_cap; put admission, replacement deltas, eviction removal, and stats all use reserved payload capacity. Cache object/allocator bookkeeping follows the C convention and is not charged.
adaptations.errors: C bool/null-out-parameter failures become Result for construction and (CacheError, Tile) for ownership-preserving insertion. Null pointers cannot be expressed by safe references/owned values. Tile dimensions and packed RGBA length are validated before insertion.
adaptations.clock: u64 tick rollover resets tick and wrapping-increments the epoch, retaining ordering by (epoch,tick). The clock injection method and exact C-order rollover test are cfg(test), matching the C VEXEL_TESTING seam without production mutability.
adaptations.threading: No synchronization is added; exclusive Rust borrowing enforces one mutable owner at a time.
